how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-redridge-mountains-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:19:obj:0: Bring Tharil'zun's Head to Marshal Marris in Redridge.
rows.quest:19:details:0: Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep. The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named Tharil'zun--we want this orc. Bring me the head of Tharil'zun!
rows.quest:19:completion:0: Tharil'zun was a vicious, crafty orc. Well done - I'm sure he didn't go down easy. Here is your reward, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:20:obj:0: Bring 10 Battleworn Axes to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:20:details:0: The Blackrock orcs have travelled from the ⟦E1⟧ and claimed Stonewatch Keep to the north. From there they maraud the areas north of Lakeshire and keep its citizens in town, penned like cattle.
rows.quest:20:details:1: BHelp rid Lakeshire of this menace. Kill these Blackrock orcs and bring me ten of their Battleworn Axes as proof.
rows.quest:20:details:2: BAnd although Blackrocks threaten us from the north, we've received reports of more in the southeastern pocket of Redridge. If you find any there, then they too should be hunted.
rows.quest:20:completion:0: That makes for a lot fewer orcs to worry about, thanks.
rows.quest:34:obj:0: Martie Jainrose of Lakeshire wants you to kill Bellygrub. Bring her his tusk as proof.
rows.quest:34:details:0: Once again my garden was trampled and pillaged. And I know the brute who is doing it. It's that forsaken boar, the one Marshal Marris has taken to calling Bellygrub.
rows.quest:34:details:1: BI won't be able to re-plant the daffodils until next season now. Ruined! All ruined by that one menacing boar. Put an end to that pest! Show me his tusk and I'd be happy to reward you. He seems to spend his time foraging in the field southwest of Lakeshire but occasionally he roams over here and into my garden.
rows.quest:34:completion:0: Finally the menace is laid to rest! Thank you, ⟦2⟧, you have done me a great service. The garden shall be in full bloom this season!
rows.quest:89:obj:0: Bring 5 Iron Pikes and 5 Iron Rivets to ⟦E2⟧ Oslow in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:89:details:0: During the last orc invasion we were forced to smelt our iron down to make bullets, swords and armor. We sent word to ⟦E3⟧ for a new shipment of materials but a band of Redridge gnolls hijacked the caravan and ran off into the hills behind Lakeshire.
rows.quest:89:details:1: BNow we're coming up short on supplies to get this bridge rebuilt. If you can bring me 5 iron pikes and 5 iron rivets, ⟦3⟧, I'll make sure you're rewarded.
rows.quest:89:completion:0: Great work, ⟦4⟧. These supplies will help the bridge effort immensely. We'll get this beauty shored up in no time.
rows.quest:91:obj:0: Bring 10 Shadowhide Pendants to Bailiff Conacher in the Lakeshire Town Hall.
rows.quest:91:details:0: An enemy of ⟦E3⟧ has taken up residence in the eastern foothills of Redridge. This wicked villain uses the ⟦E4⟧ to spread terror and misery upon our town and our people. Under the name, Morganth, he conducts his evil business.
rows.quest:91:details:1: BMorganth now controls the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan to perform his biddings. As stated by the Law of Lakeshire, aiding a criminal of the Kingdom is punishable by death.
rows.quest:91:details:2: BThese vile gnolls must be killed!
rows.quest:91:details:3: BTurn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
rows.quest:91:completion:0: The Court of Lakeshire recognizes your commitment to justice, ⟦5⟧. By enforcing the laws of the Kingdom you have helped uphold the justice of the land.
rows.quest:92:obj:0: Chef Breanna of Lakeshire wants five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
rows.quest:92:details:0: Nothing would please me more than to make you some Redridge Goulash. But there's a slight problem. During the recent orc uprising I fed the entire brigade of ⟦E3⟧ troops. My cupboard is now bare. But if you can provide me with the ingredients, I'd be happy to oblige.
rows.quest:92:details:1: BJust bring me five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
rows.quest:92:completion:0: Well done, ⟦6⟧. Such fine specimens too! And here is your delicious delicacy known as Redridge Goulash!
rows.quest:94:obj:0: Take the Glyph of Azora to the Lion Statue near the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.
rows.quest:94:details:0: My rival, Morganth, is a vicious mage of great power who lives in the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge. I have developed a means of spying on him, the Eye of Azora, and can now view him from afar.
rows.quest:94:details:1: BBut to study his thoughts ... I require further aid.
rows.quest:94:details:2: BIf you are willing, then take my Glyph of Azora to the Tower of Ilgalar. Place it upon the Lion Statue near the Tower.
rows.quest:94:details:3: BWhen this is done, the power of Azora will grant visions of Morganth's future plans.
rows.quest:94:completion:0: You place the Glyph of Azora on the stone. It adheres itself... and you hear from it Theocritus' disembodied voice:
rows.quest:94:completion:1: BYou have my gratitude, young ⟦7⟧. You may now speak with me through this Glyph, and I might have future tasks for you... after I have probed the thoughts of my rival.
rows.quest:115:obj:0: Bring 3 Midnight Orbs to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:115:details:0: The Blackrock orcs enlisted shadowcasters to aid their attacks in Redridge, and they have brought with them devices of dark power--midnight orbs. These orbs have struck telling blows against Redridge's defenders, and it's imperative we remove the demon-tainted items from the conflict.
rows.quest:115:details:1: BFind and deliver to me midnight orbs from slain Blackrock shadowcasters. I will then have them disposed of, for this world would be a better place without them!
rows.quest:115:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦8⟧. I'll send these to be destroyed immediately.
rows.quest:116:obj:0: Barkeep Daniels of Lakeshire needs a keg of Thunderbrew Lager, a cask of Merlot, a bottle of Moonshine and a skin of Sweet Rum.
rows.quest:116:details:0: I find myself in quite a pinch here, ⟦9⟧. The bottles are close to running dry. The latest booze shipment is long overdue. The orc invasion has been hell.
rows.quest:116:details:1: BPerhaps you can go to work for me?
rows.quest:116:details:2: BI need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the ⟦E5⟧ hills, a cask of Merlot from ⟦E3⟧, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire. Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
rows.quest:116:completion:0: A job well done, ⟦10⟧! I know well the roads you had to journey to procure this fine array of liquor. But my patrons will be happy once again!
rows.quest:116:completion:1: BMy wife is quite a seamstress. Please accept this cloak she made in return for your services.
rows.quest:118:obj:0: Take Verner's Note to Smith Argus in Goldshire.
rows.quest:118:details:0: I've been using so much iron keeping the ⟦E3⟧ Guards outfitted, I don't have enough to supply the stable's horses with shoes!
rows.quest:118:details:1: BTake this note to Blacksmith Argus in Goldshire. It explains to him my problem and requests a shipment of horseshoes.
rows.quest:118:completion:0: Heh, so old Verner needs some shoes, does he!?!
rows.quest:119:obj:0: Return to Verner Osgood in Redridge. Give him the Crate of Horseshoes.
rows.quest:119:details:0: Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...
rows.quest:119:details:1: BHere they are, all boxed up and ready to go! Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!
rows.quest:119:completion:0: Thank you, this really helps me out.
rows.quest:119:completion:1: BBut what's this? Argus sent a note with the crate...What?? Argus wants me to PAY him? Bah!
rows.quest:119:completion:2: BWell, ⟦11⟧, thank you for your help.
rows.quest:120:obj:0: Magistrate ⟦E6⟧ has given you a report which must be delivered to ⟦E7⟧ in ⟦E3⟧. The judge wants you to return to him as soon as the delivery has been made.
rows.quest:120:details:0: These are trying times, ⟦12⟧. The township is under constant siege. Without reinforcements, we will certainly face defeat. The message I now entrust to you is of utmost importance. Get this report to ⟦E7⟧ of ⟦E3⟧ immediately. Once your delivery is made, return to me at once with any news, be it good or bad.
rows.quest:120:completion:1: BMagistrate ⟦E6⟧ is a noble leader. His words carry great weight with me. I shall seek the counsel of the King and make the situation clear to him. Assure the good judge that he has the ⟦E3⟧ Army's support. Reinforcements will be sent as soon as word is given from His Majesty.
rows.quest:121:obj:0: Take ⟦E7⟧'s letter of response to Magistrate ⟦E6⟧ in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:121:details:0: While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:121:completion:0: Thank you for your time, ⟦15⟧. For your service to Lakeshire and ⟦E3⟧ I reward you with these coins.
rows.quest:121:completion:1: BNow if you'll excuse me, I find this correspondence somewhat of a mystery. Something is amiss in our Kingdom. I fear this is the beginning of conflict, not the end.
rows.quest:122:obj:0: Gather 6 Underbelly Whelp Scales from Black Dragon Whelps, and bring them to Verner Osgood in Redridge.
rows.quest:122:details:0: I need some underbelly scales from black dragon whelps to pay for the shoes Argus sent me from Goldshire. If you can get 6 of them for me, then I can pay Argus with some... and have enough left to fashion something for you.
rows.quest:122:details:1: BBlack dragon whelps are often flying around south of Lakeshire, but they like to wander. You might have to just keep an eye out and hunt them when you see them.
rows.quest:122:completion:0: Thanks! These will get me out of debt to Argus...
rows.quest:124:obj:0: Kill 10 Redridge Brutes and 8 Redridge Mystics, then return to Verner Osgood.
rows.quest:124:details:0: As if the attacking orcs weren't enough! Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray...
rows.quest:124:details:1: BIf you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.
rows.quest:124:completion:0: Thank you for all your help, ⟦16⟧.
rows.quest:125:obj:0: ⟦E2⟧ Oslow of Lakeshire wants you to retrieve his toolbox from the bottom of Lake Everstill.
rows.quest:125:details:0: I could really use a hand here, ⟦17⟧. With the town under siege, it's been hard to get supplies. My tools were being delivered from Goldshire by wagon but the bridge was blown out. We put the tools in a boat but the orcs hit it with a catapult. Just my luck, my toolbox sank right to the bottom of the lake.
rows.quest:125:details:1: BRetrieve my toolbox, ⟦18⟧, and I'll make it worth your while.
rows.quest:125:completion:0: Excellent recovery, ⟦19⟧! I never thought I'd see these tools again.
rows.quest:126:obj:0: Bring Yowler's Paw to Verner Osgood in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:126:details:0: ⟦20⟧, the gnolls are still out there. I can hear their baying as they hunt in the hills above Lakeshire. And one cry is louder than the rest - Yowler, their leader.
rows.quest:126:details:1: BKill Yowler and send his pack scattering! Bring me his paw as proof.
rows.quest:126:details:2: BAnd be careful, this gnoll is their leader for a reason. He is no Mongrel...
rows.quest:126:completion:0: Again, thank you for your help. The ⟦E3⟧ army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
rows.quest:127:obj:0: Bring 10 Spotted Sunfish to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:127:details:0: Lake Everstill is famous for its spotted sunfish. There's always demand for them...and I'm running low!
rows.quest:127:details:1: BBring me a batch of 10 and I'll barter well for them. If you can't fish yourself, then...maybe you can get them off the murlocs!
rows.quest:127:completion:0: Pleasure doin' business with you, matey!
rows.quest:128:obj:0: Kill 15 Blackrock Champions and Guard Howe in Lakeshire will reward you.
rows.quest:128:details:0: The Blackrock Clan must be destroyed. The Enemy has invaded our lands. These mountains fall under the sovereign right of the King of ⟦E3⟧. Our sources tell us that the leaders of each unit within the Clan are known as Champions. You'll find them in their encampment to the north, just west of the road to the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:128:details:1: BMagistrate ⟦E6⟧ wants these foul brutes dead. Slay 15 Blackrock Champions and return to me.
rows.quest:128:completion:0: I see you have fought valiantly against the Blackrock Clan, ⟦21⟧. Your service to our township is great indeed.
rows.quest:129:obj:0: Bring Parker's lunch to Guard Parker. He patrols the road leading to Darkshire.
rows.quest:129:details:0: Can you do me a favor? I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol...he's a big, strong ⟦E3⟧ guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me.
rows.quest:129:details:1: BSo if you deliver his lunch for me, then come back here and I'll give you a free lunch! Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:129:completion:0: Thanks, I could really use the meal. Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!
rows.quest:130:obj:0: Speak with the Redridge Herbalist, Martie Jainrose.
rows.quest:130:details:0: Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me? You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.
rows.quest:130:details:1: BBut when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...
rows.quest:130:completion:0: You need a bouquet of flowers? You haven't been in town very long...have you already found for yourself a sweetheart here?
rows.quest:130:completion:1: BI know I shouldn't pry, but it's nice to see that love is in the air... especially in dangerous times like these.
rows.quest:131:details:0: Here is your bouquet. I chose Daffodils for you. They're my favorite!
rows.quest:131:completion:0: Oh, those are lovely! I can't wait to put them in some water!
rows.quest:131:completion:1: BBut...these are Martie's favorite flowers. Parker didn't have you go to that jealous vixen for this bouquet, did he? You didn't tell her who they were for, did you? If you did, then it wouldn't surprise me if she poisoned them.
rows.quest:131:completion:2: BOh, but it's not your fault. Thank you, and here's your meal.
rows.quest:143:obj:0: Magistrate ⟦E6⟧ wants you to take his written plea to Gryan Stoutmantle in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:143:details:0: Something odd is afoot with the ⟦E3⟧ Army. They should have been here in force by now. Time is a luxury we don't have, however. I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help. I've heard word of a people's militia forming in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:143:details:1: BTake this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle. Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.
rows.quest:143:completion:0: Good Messenger, you have served your master well.
rows.quest:144:obj:0: Return to Magistrate ⟦E6⟧ with Gryan Stoutmantle's response.
rows.quest:144:details:0: Magistrate ⟦E6⟧'s note pains me to read. But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in ⟦E5⟧ or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia. If ⟦E3⟧ had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.
rows.quest:144:details:1: BTake this response to your master in Redridge, ⟦22⟧. And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.
rows.quest:144:completion:0: I do say, this is not good at all. I did not realize that Stoutmantle's situation was not unlike ours here in Lakeshire. What action is so important that it calls the ⟦E3⟧ Army away from its people? Bah, I should not ponder aloud.
rows.quest:144:completion:1: BHere, messenger. Accept these coins in exchange for your service to the Township. I might call upon you again.
rows.quest:145:obj:0: Magistrate ⟦E6⟧ wants you to take a letter to Lord Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
rows.quest:145:details:0: I require your assistance once again. I have written to Lord Ebonlocke, requesting that he sends his trained guards, the Night Watch, to help with Lakeshire's defense. It is imperative this message makes it to him swiftly. You must exercise extreme caution. Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire, in the heart of ⟦E8⟧. Do not stray from the roads.
rows.quest:145:completion:0: Thank you for making the long journey here. This is indeed important information.
rows.quest:146:obj:0: Return to Magistrate ⟦E6⟧ with Lord Ebonlocke's letter of response.
rows.quest:146:details:0: If I did not know Magistrate ⟦E6⟧ personally, I would say the man has gone mad. Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because ⟦E3⟧ refuses aid? The Night Watch was formed because ⟦E3⟧ left us when this foul magic seeped into the land. If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.
rows.quest:146:details:1: BTake this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:146:completion:0: By the Light! The ⟦E3⟧ Army retreated from ⟦E5⟧. And the Guard no longer protects Darkshire? There is some treachery abound. How could this be so?
rows.quest:146:completion:1: BOh I forgot to reward your service, ⟦23⟧. Here are some coins. Now excuse me. Something is amiss in ⟦E3⟧ and I must get to the bottom of it.
rows.quest:150:obj:0: Bring 8 Murloc Fins to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:150:details:0: Murlocs are becoming a problem. Larger groups of the fishmen are dropping anchor along the shores of Lake Everstill and fishing up a storm! We need them gone before they eat all the fish in the lake!
rows.quest:150:details:1: BHunt murlocs! Bring me eight of their fins and I might have something for you...
rows.quest:150:completion:0: Well done, ⟦24⟧. I hope you didn't have too much trouble with those murlocs.
rows.quest:150:completion:1: BIt's strange seeing them so far from the sea. I wonder if they're here because they're running from something...
rows.quest:169:obj:0: Kill Gath'Ilzogg and bring his head to Magistrate ⟦E6⟧ in Lakeshire for the reward.
rows.quest:169:details:0: Wanted! Gath'Ilzogg, Leader of the Blackrock attacks on Stonewatch Keep and raids against the township of Lakeshire.
rows.quest:169:details:1: BGath'Ilzogg is extremely dangerous. He is reportedly holed up in the recently conquered keep plotting the Blackrock clan's further crimes against humanity. The orc infestation must be quelled at all costs. A gracious reward will be given to whatever brave soul can deliver the head of Gath'Ilzogg to Magistrate ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:169:completion:0: Fantastic work, ⟦25⟧! Gath'Ilzogg led those brutes into battle, killing many innocent humans. Vindication is ours. This is the first step in reclaiming the keep for the kingdom of ⟦E3⟧!
rows.quest:178:obj:0: Bring the Faded Shadowhide Pendant to Theocritus the Mage.
rows.quest:178:details:1: BDo not be alarmed. I am Theocritus, High Mage of Tower Azora in ⟦E9⟧. The pendant you are holding is a method of communication between the Shadowhide Gnolls and their master, Morganth.
rows.quest:178:details:2: BThrough months of research, I believe I too can communicate through these pendants. If you can hear this message, then my spell was a success.
rows.quest:178:details:3: BBring me this pendant and I will reward you for the service.
rows.quest:178:completion:0: You have my gratitude, ⟦27⟧. I sent that message to the Shadowhide Pendants weeks ago and had believed it a failure. But it seems the spell did reach at least some pendants, after a significant delay.
rows.quest:178:completion:1: BIn time I hope to learn how to send an attack through the pendants, to immobilize any Shadowhide Gnolls who wear them.
rows.quest:178:completion:2: BBut before that is possible, I'm afraid that much more research is required.
rows.quest:180:obj:0: Kill Lieutenant Fangore and return to Magistrate ⟦E6⟧ in Lakeshire with his paw.
rows.quest:180:details:1: BKnown leader of the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan, working under the enemy of the Township and Kingdom, Morganth. By mandate of Magistrate ⟦E6⟧, this vile betrayer of ⟦E3⟧ is wanted dead. Show his paw to the Magistrate as proof of his death.
rows.quest:180:completion:0: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead? Good riddance to that foul creature. You are very brave, ⟦28⟧. The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
rows.quest:219:obj:0: Protect Corporal Keeshan on the journey back to Redridge.
rows.quest:219:details:2: BThe last thing I remember these foul Orcs overpowered our regiment. Most the men were killed. I took a strong blow to the head and everything went black. Now I am held captive in this cave. Help me, I am hurt badly.
rows.quest:219:details:3: BI'll need help getting back to town... please... you're my last hope...
rows.quest:219:completion:0: You have served the Kingdom well, ⟦29⟧. Thank you for assisting Corporal Keeshan with his escape from those dreaded Blackrock Orcs. You shall be rewarded for your brave acts this day.
rows.quest:244:details:0: Hail, ⟦30⟧. I am charged to patrol this stretch of road. Although the road is safe for now, I've seen gnoll encampments to the north and east of here.
rows.quest:244:details:1: BLakeshire must know of the gathering gnoll force! Report to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire and tell him of the gnolls. Do this, and I'm sure Feldon will offer you a scout's wage.
rows.quest:244:details:2: BFeldon's usually inspecting the area south of the bridge to Lakeshire.
rows.quest:244:completion:0: There are Redridge gnolls that close to Elwynn?? They may be poised to advance into our homeland. Soon the people of Lakeshire may not be the only humans under siege!
rows.quest:244:completion:1: BHere is your pay, though you bring us dire news. And it comes at a bad time, for we are ill equipped to deal with it.
rows.quest:246:obj:0: Kill 10 Redridge Mongrels and 6 Redridge Poachers, then report back to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:246:details:0: We don't have men to spare, but something must be done about those gnolls you reported to me.
rows.quest:246:details:1: BScout southern Redridge for gnolls. Harry them, kill those you can and report back to me with a count of their numbers and an assessment of the threat they present. You may find those gnolls camped all along the southern road of Redridge.
rows.quest:246:details:2: BDo this for the ⟦E3⟧ Army, ⟦31⟧, and you will be rewarded.
rows.quest:246:completion:1: BThere's a sizable force of gnolls encamped there, and from what you tell me they are tough ones. It must not have been easy for you to gather this intelligence.
rows.quest:246:completion:2: BHere you are, ⟦32⟧. We are grateful for your aid.
rows.quest:246:completion:3: BAnd if you haven't already done so, speak with Marshal Marris and Magistrate ⟦E6⟧ within Lakeshire. Our situation grows ever more desperate - those two will have need of you I'm sure.
rows.quest:248:obj:0: Climb the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.
rows.quest:248:obj:1: BFind a suitable container to place the Glyph of Azora.
rows.quest:248:details:0: I have been watching the Tower of Ilgalar, and can detect that Morganth is in conflict with the Orcs in Stonewatch Keep. I do not know the reason behind their contention, but you may aid me in unraveling this mystery.
rows.quest:248:details:1: BTake another Glyph of Azora, then go to the top of the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.
rows.quest:248:details:2: BFind a suitable object on which to place the Glyph. A chest or a jar -- some place where the glyph will not be noticed -- will suit my purpose.
rows.quest:248:completion:0: It is a suitable vessel for the Glyph of Azora, allowing Theocritus to delve into the minds within Stonewatch Keep.
rows.quest:249:obj:1: BBring his Pendant of Shadow to Theocritus at the Tower of Azora in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:249:details:0: After much observation, I have discovered Morganth's plans.
rows.quest:249:details:1: BHe searches for the Scythe of ⟦E11⟧...and he may have found it! If he has, then the ⟦E12⟧, and the kingdom of ⟦E3⟧, will soon feel his dark might.
rows.quest:249:details:2: BI am not prepared to pit myself against Morganth, but I fear he must be dealt with now. So you must enter the Tower of Ilgalar and face Morganth.
rows.quest:249:details:3: BDefeat him, and bring me his Pendant of Shadow. Do this, and the kingdom will owe you much.
rows.quest:249:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦33⟧. In defeating the warlock Morganth, ⟦E3⟧ is saved from a grave peril.
rows.quest:249:completion:1: BI offer you this reward most humbly. And I would bid you peace, if these were peaceful times.
rows.quest:249:completion:2: BBut instead, I will bid you luck with your trials, and victory in the conflicts ahead.
rows.quest:3741:obj:0: Find Hilary's Necklace, and return it to Hilary in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:3741:details:0: My friend Hilary lost her necklace, and we can't find it. We've been fishing all day right here, and we looked around here already. The only thing I can think of is that it fell into the lake. Our parents don't want us to swim in the lake... my mom says there's some mean things underwater, but you look like you aren't scared of mean things.
rows.quest:3741:details:1: BCould you find it for her, please?
rows.quest:3741:completion:0: Thank you for finding my necklace mister ⟦34⟧... you are very kind! My kitty thanks you too - isn't that right Effsee?
